<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" modified="2026-11-15T15:00:00.000Z" agent="Antigravity" version="21.0.0" type="device"> <diagram id="arch_simple" name="PWM Controller Architecture (Clean)"> <mxGraphModel dx="1200" dy="800" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1000" pageHeight="700" background="#FFFFFF" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" />
<!-- Title Header --> <mxCell id="hdr_title" value="<b>8-CHANNEL PWM CONTROLLER — ARCHITECTURE OVERVIEW (8-BIT)</b>" style="text;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;fontSize=15;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#0F172A;fontFamily=Helvetica;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="220" y="10" width="560" height="25" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Top-Level Wrapper: pwm_8ch_controller --> <mxCell id="top_box" value="<b>pwm_8ch_controller</b> <span style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: normal; color: #475569;">(Top-Level RTL Wrapper)</span>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FAFAFA;strokeColor=#334155;strokeWidth=2.5;dashed=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=18;spacingTop=12;fontSize=14;fontColor=#0F172A;fontFamily=Helvetica;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="160" y="42" width="680" height="625" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Clock and Reset Input --> <mxCell id="wire_clk_rst" value="" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;strokeColor=#64748B;strokeWidth=2;endFill=1;" edge="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry width="50" height="50" relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="60" y="65" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="160" y="65" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lbl_clk_rst" value="<b>clk, arst_n</b>" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=bottom;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;fontSize=11;fontColor=#475569;fontFamily=Helvetica;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="60" y="45" width="80" height="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- SUBMODULE 1: pwm_registers --> <mxCell id="mod_regs" value="<b><font style="font-size: 15px;">pwm_registers</font></b><br><font style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: normal; color: #1E40AF;">Bus Interface & Configuration Storage</font><hr style="margin: 6px 0; border: none; border-top: 1px solid #BFDBFE;"><div style="text-align: left; padding-left: 20px; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: normal; color: #0F172A; line-height: 1.5;">• <b>DUTY_CH0..7 Registers [7:0]</b> — Duty cycle thresholds for channels 0 to 7 (Addr 0x0 – 0x7)<br>• <b>CH_EN Register [7:0]</b> — Individual channel enables <i>ch_en[0..7]</i> (Addr 0x8)</div>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EFF6FF;strokeColor=#2563EB;strokeWidth=2;align=center;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=10;fontSize=14;fontColor=#1E3A8A;fontFamily=Helvetica;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="200" y="88" width="600" height="105" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Bus Interface Inputs (Left) --> <mxCell id="wire_bus_in" value="" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;strokeColor=#0F172A;strokeWidth=2.5;endFill=1;" edge="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry width="50" height="50" relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="15" y="125" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="200" y="125" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lbl_bus_in" value="<b>addr[3:0], wrdata[7:0], wen</b>" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=bottom;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;fontSize=11;fontColor=#0F172A;fontFamily=Helvetica;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="15" y="103" width="180" height="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Bus Interface Output rdata (Left) --> <mxCell id="wire_bus_out" value="" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;strokeColor=#0F172A;strokeWidth=2.5;endFill=1;" edge="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry width="50" height="50" relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="200" y="162" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="15" y="162" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lbl_bus_out" value="<b>rdata[7:0]</b>" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=bottom;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;fontSize=11;fontColor=#0F172A;fontFamily=Helvetica;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="85" y="164" width="80" height="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Left Bypass Wire: duty_reg[0..7] from Registers to Channels --> <mxCell id="wire_duty_bypass" value="" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;strokeColor=#2563EB;strokeWidth=2.5;endFill=1;" edge="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry width="50" height="50" relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="230" y="193" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="230" y="435" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lbl_duty_bypass" value="<b>duty_reg[0..7]</b>" style="text;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;strokeColor=none;fillColor=#FAFAFA;rounded=1;fontSize=11;fontColor=#1E40AF;fontFamily=Helvetica;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="175" y="218" width="90" height="18" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Right Bypass Wire: ch_en[0..7] from Registers to Channels --> <mxCell id="wire_en_bypass" value="" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;strokeColor=#2563EB;strokeWidth=2.5;endFill=1;" edge="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry width="50" height="50" relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="770" y="193" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="770" y="435" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lbl_en_bypass" value="<b>ch_en[0..7]</b>" style="text;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;strokeColor=none;fillColor=#FAFAFA;rounded=1;fontSize=11;fontColor=#1E40AF;fontFamily=Helvetica;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="715" y="218" width="90" height="18" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- SUBMODULE 2: pwm_counter --> <mxCell id="mod_cnt" value="<b><font style="font-size: 15px;">pwm_counter</font></b><br><font style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: normal; color: #15803D;">Shared 8-Bit Free-Running Timing Base</font><hr style="margin: 6px 0; border: none; border-top: 1px solid #BBF7D0;"><div style="text-align: left; padding-left: 20px; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: normal; color: #0F172A; line-height: 1.5;">• <b>8-Bit Free-Running Up-Counter</b> — continuous modulo-256 counter (0 to 255)<br>• <b>Period Tick Generator</b> — 1-cycle strobe (<i>period_tick</i>) at rollover (255)</div>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#F0FDF4;strokeColor=#16A34A;strokeWidth=2;align=center;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=10;fontSize=14;fontColor=#14532D;fontFamily=Helvetica;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="290" y="265" width="420" height="100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Timing Wire 1: count[7:0] from Counter to Channels --> <mxCell id="wire_cnt_val" value="" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;strokeColor=#16A34A;strokeWidth=2.5;endFill=1;" edge="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry width="50" height="50" relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="410" y="365" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="410" y="435" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lbl_cnt_val" value="<b>count[7:0]</b>" style="text;html=1;align=right;verticalAlign=middle;strokeColor=none;fillColor=#FAFAFA;rounded=1;fontSize=11;fontColor=#15803D;fontFamily=Helvetica;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="340" y="390" width="65" height="18" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- Timing Wire 2: period_tick from Counter to Channels --> <mxCell id="wire_tick_val" value="" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;strokeColor=#16A34A;strokeWidth=2.5;endFill=1;" edge="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry width="50" height="50" relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="590" y="365" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="590" y="435" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lbl_tick_val" value="<b>period_tick</b>" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;strokeColor=none;fillColor=#FAFAFA;rounded=1;fontSize=11;fontColor=#15803D;fontFamily=Helvetica;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="598" y="390" width="70" height="18" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- SUBMODULE 3: pwm_channel [0..7] Instances --> <mxCell id="mod_chan" value="<b><font style="font-size: 15px;">pwm_channel [0..7] Instances</font></b><br><font style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: normal; color: #7E22CE;">8 Independent Glitch-Free Channel Slices</font><hr style="margin: 6px 0; border: none; border-top: 1px solid #E9D5FF;"><div style="text-align: left; padding-left: 20px; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: normal; color: #0F172A; line-height: 1.5;">• <b>Shadow Duty Register</b> — latches <i>duty_reg[i]</i> synchronously on <i>period_tick</i> or when <i>!ch_en[i]</i><br>• <b>8-Bit Magnitude Comparator</b> — generates raw PWM pulse: <i>(count < duty_shadow[i])</i><br>• <b>Output Enable Gating</b> — <i>pwm_out[i] = ch_en[i] & raw_pwm</i></div>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=8;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FAF5FF;strokeColor=#9333EA;strokeWidth=2;align=center;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=10;fontSize=14;fontColor=#581C87;fontFamily=Helvetica;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="200" y="435" width="600" height="125" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
<!-- PWM Output Wire (Bottom Out) --> <mxCell id="wire_pwm_out" value="" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;strokeColor=#9333EA;strokeWidth=3;endFill=1;" edge="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry width="50" height="50" relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="500" y="560" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="500" y="650" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lbl_pwm_out" value="<b>pwm_out[7:0]</b><br><span style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: normal; color: #581C87;">(8-Channel PWM Outputs)</span>" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;fontSize=12.5;fontColor=#581C87;fontFamily=Helvetica;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="512" y="590" width="180" height="35" as="geometry" /> </mxCell>
</root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
